title: Pokemon TCG Ortega Prismatic Evolutions 141/131 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokemon Trading Card Game card from the Prismatic Evolutions set, specifically the Ortega card illustrated by Teeziro. It is an English language Ultra Rare card with a Holo finish. Manufactured by The Pokemon Company, this Trainer card is numbered 141 out of 131 in the set. With its rarity and desirable features, this Ortega card would be a sought-after addition to any collector's deck.
